svg.title: The Percentages Behind the First Contract
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-first-contract-percentages; chapter number: 2; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: The Percentages Behind the First Contract; subtitle: Won on dependability and margin discipline, not the lowest bid; unit: percent; caption: Roughly 90% of commercial prospects already have a cleaner; refusing to be the cheapest bid lifted one closing rate from 10% to 25-35%, while margin floors sit at 30% with about 25% for strategic accounts.; assumptions note: Where a practitioner gave a range without a typical value, typical is the midpoint of that range. Single-point claims use the same figure for min, max and typical.; note: Sources Cleaning Launch (V84a_KWRYU4 at 00:01:22); ONLY MAIDS PODCAST with Joseph D Adams (aQj7G__L-iE at 00:07:34 and 00:08:41); OctoClean Media (1tf8JMWxi98 at 00:00:44).; bars: label: Prospects already with a cleaner; min: 90; max: 90; typical: 90; display: About 90%; label: Close rate competing as cheapest; min: 10; max: 10; typical: 10; display: 10% (Cleaning Launch, before); label: Close rate refusing cheapest; min: 25; max: 35; typical: 30; display: 25-35% (Cleaning Launch, after); label: Target contract margin; min: 25; max: 30; typical: 30; display: 30% standard, about 25% strategic (Adams); label: Price float when budget stalls; min: 25; max: 30; typical: 27.5; display: 25-30% higher number (OctoClean Media)

text.title: Assumptions: Where a practitioner gave a range without a typical value, typical is the midpoint of that range. Single-point claims use the same figure for min, max and typical.
